_note: Per-player weekly ADVANCED stats (EPA, air yards, CPOE, RACR/WOPR), regular season, offense only. Sibling store to component_stats — same crosswalk, same player-week grain, joined downstream by (pid, week), not by row identity. Missing-vs-zero: continuous metrics (pass_epa/rush_epa/rec_epa/cpoe/racr) keep a real 0.0 and drop only NaN; integer/share metrics (pass_air_yd/rec_air_yd/wopr/ay_share) drop a real 0 same as every prior store. Row-presence still means 'recorded an offensive stat row that week' — absence is missing data, never a zero.

provenance.schema: stats_player_week (measured to be the only schema of the two nflverse releases checked that carries passing_cpoe; see module docstring)
provenance.crosswalk: nfl_data_py.import_ids() gsis_id -> sleeper_id; unmapped players keyed gsis:<id>, never dropped
